children.name: Authorization: "Sign in again?" popup, token renewal, Copy details
401: after Log out in another tab the next request shows the popup, the widgets stay on screen
Copy details on the "Sign in again?" popup: the JSON has session, screen, view, request, status and timings
401: "Yes" logs out and opens the login page, signing in again restores the application
401: "No" closes the popup and further failing requests do not reopen it while the answer is remembered
